                                     ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1; Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
and symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 8-F in the area bounded by:

     A line 273.25 feet north of West 38th Street;
     the alley next east of and parallel to South Parnell Avenue;
     a line 248.25 feet north of West 38th Street; and
     South Parnell Avenue;

to those of RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, which is
hereby established in the area above described.


SECTION 2: This ordinance shall take effect upon its passage and due publication.




Common Address(es): 3733 S. Parnell Ave., Chicago, Illinois.
